notes.title: Patch Note (ver 2.0.1)
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience. 
It's been about 9 months since I launched it. I've finally released a "Survival Circle" in a different language.
Now enjoy the game in [u][b]English[/b][/u]. You can change the language in the option!

No other languages are on the schedule yet. I'll let you know when I get any related news.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44733637/29d49df22113dc160ead0c14147064caa0315bc1.png[/img]


[b]Other content[/b]
[list]
[*] You can check the volume of each character right away in the option.
[*] Fixed a "frustration" achievement error. If you've met existing achievement requirements, you can get achievements by accessing the game.
[*] There's an opinion that the indicator is small, so I zoomed in more. It's noticeable now, right?
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note (ver. 1.0.7)
notes.content:
Other matters
-We modified the missing text.
-We simplified the script for some overlapping endings, changing the connection to be natural.

notes.title: Patch Note (ver 1.0.6)
notes.content:
-Improved difficulty of face-to-face parts with criminals
**In previous games, we had to collect clues within that episode, but now we've improved it so that any clues we've ever collected in any episode can always be used.

- When the correct answer is selected, the visual effect is strengthened.
**There was an opinion that it was difficult to grasp the correct answer only by the criminal's reaction. We reinforced the visual effect to show that it was the correct answer more clearly.

- Added a new choice for the reasoning part
**If you follow the reasoning, you can't avoid the bad ending, but you were seen continuing to try because of the possibility that it could change due to the nature of the loop. Therefore, we added a specific choice to the reasoning part, and envisioned a direction other than deliberately failing the reasoning.

notes.title: Patch Notes (ver 1.0.5)
notes.content:
-At the start of the game, a guide/warning statement will be displayed.

-If you go back to the beginning while playing, you can start right from 2st.
**Some values will also be maintained without needing to be revisited.

-Improved difficulty

-We have added three more types of information that will be printed at the end of the game.

**There were a lot of people talking about the difficulty of the game, and there were people who were confused in a much more time loop than I expected. For smoother gameplay, we added hints and guides to the next story when certain conditions are met.
